name: update_change_log
description:
Appends a human-readable entry to the project changelog in agent memory.
Use when: completing a feature, fixing a bug, or making a notable architectural change worth recording for collaborators or future agents.
Scope: local filesystem (CHANGELOG.md in memory dir). No network access.
Not for: session event logging (use memory_log), milestone tracking (use update_milestones).

description.description: What changed. Be concise but specific.

change_type.description: Type of change: feat (new feature), fix (bug fix), refactor, docs, test, chore, breaking (breaking change).

version.description: Optional version tag. Example: 'v1.2.0'. Groups entries under a version header.

scope.description: Optional scope — what area of the project. Example: 'webapp', 'memory', 'github-tools'.
